methodology:
First Resources is a Singapore-listed Indonesian palm oil pure-play with 213K+ hectares across Riau (Sumatra), East Kalimantan, and West Kalimantan. The Ciliandra Perkasa subsidiary holds the Riau core; East and West Kalimantan are smaller clusters.

3-row breakdown:
- Riau (198K acres): core region with 4 mills + Pelintung/Dumai processing — premium per-acre due to mill density
- East Kalimantan (195K acres): plantation with 2 mills
- West Kalimantan (128K acres): smaller cluster with 1 mill

First Resources is one of the higher-quality SGX-listed palm operators with $420M EBITDA on $1,039M revenue (FY24) reflecting operational excellence. Net PP&E book of $1,500M allocated by region. Reports in USD; lists in SGD (priceCurrency: SGD).
